title.narrative: Maya Nutri II: Fortalecimiento de la Seguridad Alimentaria Nutricional

description.narrative: The Maya Nutri II project generates a transformative impact on the Maya Chortí communities of the Dry Corridor of Guatemala by overcoming barriers to access and availability of food, guaranteeing the human right to adequate food for indigenous children and adolescents through greater production and consumption of nutritious food in rural homes and schools. Chronic malnutrition that affects physical and cognitive development is reduced, promoting hygiene, safety and healthy eating practices, along with an increase in male co-responsibility in care, with 52% of female beneficiaries empowered as leaders and protagonists of change. Through school and community agroecological gardens, native seed banks, community kitchens, and improved school feeding, sustainable livelihoods are strengthened and resilient local production is increased. At the same time, practices of seed conservation, reforestation of micro-watersheds and sustainable management of natural resources increase the capacity to adapt to climate change, protecting the right to a healthy environment. The project strengthens Seeds for Progress and community commissions (COCOSAN/COLRED) through robust monitoring systems, knowledge management and public-private partnerships, ensuring institutional sustainability. Thus, ESCERs are fully exercised, promoting integral human development, gender equity and more resilient, sovereign and healthy rural communities.
